title: Rollout Safety Orchestrator - quality-metrics-driven rollback and staged remediation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Rollout Safety Orchestrator (RSO) that monitors quality regressions tied to config and model changes during Canary and A/B rollouts and automatically executes staged rollback/remediation policies. The RSO will evaluate cohort-level signals (semantic quality, hallucination indicators, latency, error-rate, and downstream metrics) using sequential hypothesis testing and run-rate-normalized deltas. If degradation crosses adaptive thresholds and persists over multiple windows, RSO performs a progressive remediation plan (traffic clamp -> model swap -> full rollback) and records audit events for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: RSO ingests per-cohort eval metrics and production telemetry every 30s into a time-windowed aggregator
Support configurable policies: threshold, window-size, consecutive-windows-to-trigger, min-sample-size, and escalation plan
Automated actions: clamp traffic by X%, shift cohort to fallback model variant, or revert to previous pinned version via existing rollout API
Statistical tests: support sequential t-test and nonparametric Mann-Whitney uplift with FDR control for multiple-metric gating
Safety: all automated rollbacks require an auditable event with diff and runbook link; opt-in/opt-out per-customer and per-environment
E2E tests that simulate degraded quality and verify each remediation step executes and emits dashboard alerts and Slack notifications
Backward compatibility: RSO uses existing rollout APIs so Dedicated/Private deployments can adopt with minimal infra changes
Performance: evaluation pipeline adds <5ms median overhead to request path metrics collection and does not increase tail p99 latency
tasks: Design: Confluence doc describing statistical approach, API hooks, and escalation playbook (owner: Aisha)
Instrumentation: extend metric exporter to emit cohort-aware hashes and sample weights (owner: Priya Rao)
Policy engine: implement rule DSL for threshold/window/escalation and tie to rollout API (owner: Marco Chen)
Orchestrator: build orchestrator that executes clamp/swap/revert steps and writes audit log entries (owner: Daniel Ortiz)
Dashboards: create per-rollout watchboard and anomaly heatmap; wire alerts to Slack channel #rollout-safety (owner: Lina Gomez)
E2E & load tests: simulate traffic with synthetic regressions to validate triggering and non-triggering paths (owner: Eng QA)
Docs: user guide for PMs and SREs with examples and recommended defaults for thresholds and sample sizes (owner: DevRel)
Security review: confirm KMS/HSM and audit log retention requirements for private installs (owner: Security)
Migration: rollout plan for enabling RSO by default for new canaries and opt-in for existing ones (owner: Product)
Postmortem hook: add automatic incident creation template when an automated rollback happens (owner: SRE)
